messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly from me — high level items and asks. TL;DR: private beta target moved to next Tue (soft GA window), please observe a code/config freeze Wed–Fri for the launch. We had two low-sev infra incidents last week; customer impact negligible but root causes being tracked. Operational asks: keep p95 latency under 160ms during canary, tighten data-retention appendix for Private customers, and add +1 on oncall during rollout. I'll call out ownership below. :eyes:

Diego (VP, Product): +1 on the freeze. Updated the launch checklist in Notion (link in #product). Need final canary metric thresholds + sign-off by EOD Thu. Also FYI Acme onboarding requested earlier window — may need dedicated slot.

Maya (Head of Eng): Understood. Quick Q: can we allow coordinated security patches during the freeze? Also what's our rollback window for the canary cohorts?

Jun (Director, Ops): Security patches are OK if we coordinate through #eng-oncall and log them in the launch doc. Rollback window is 30m for the initial canary cohorts; Ops will staff an extra rotations for Tue–Thu.

Nina (Comms): I'll draft an internal 3-line and an external blurb once we lock the canary thresholds. Ava — can you provide a 1-2 sentence quote by EOD Thu for the external note?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated on prod-cluster at 2387654330 by Diego. Status: pending metric evaluation.

Ava (CEO): Good. Maya — coordinate security patch requests via #eng-oncall and tag me if it's >15m effort. Diego — please paste the canary dashboard link here when ready.

Diego (VP, Product): Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/canary (placeholder). Sharing the metric baseline: p50 30ms, p95 190ms currently; target during canary is p95 <= 160ms and error rate <0.1%. Pinged @Customer Success about Acme slot.

Maya (Head of Eng): Ack, coordinating with oncall and SRE. We'll prioritize any critical patches but avoid config churn. :thumbsup:

Jun (Director, Ops): One more operational change: for Private customers we will shorten log retention to 90 days by default (legal reviewed). Please update docs and runbook references.

Nina (Comms): Copy that — I'll prep the external blurb + an internal comms snippet for #all-hands. Will post draft for review in #announcements-drafts.

Ava (CEO): Thanks all. Final asks: keep burn and token-cost visibility high during the beta, flag any latency regressions immediately, and escalate any customer-facing anomalies to me + Diego. Small wins: team reduced tail latency by 10% in two weeks — keep it up.

Diego (VP, Product): Thanks — rolling forward.

Maya (Head of Eng): Will monitor dashboards and report any anomalies.

Jun (Director, Ops): Ops will publish oncall rota for launch day by EOD Mon.

Nina (Comms): I'll have draft comms by Thu morning.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics check complete at 2387654358. Result: p95=158ms, error_rate=0.05% — passing thresholds.

Ava (CEO): Excellent — keep the momentum.
